description: Forget a stand-in sport the sync learnt for an athlete, as the remove button on the profile's "Recording stand-ins" list does. Recordings already placed stay where they are; only later syncs stop using the rule.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

planned_sport.description: The planned sport it stood in for, e.g. rollski

recorded_sport.description: The sport the recording was, e.g. inlineskate
